full.description: This is a gross specimen image showing three small, nodular tissue samples next to a centimeter scale. The tissues appear reddish and fleshy, characteristic of endocrine or glandular structures. Based on their appearance and size, these represent adrenal cortical nodules or adenomas. Such findings are typical in cases of endocrine hyperfunction or incidentalomas.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph displaying three excised tissue specimens against a purple surgical towel, accompanied by a centimeter scale. The reddish-brown specimens are lobulated and vary in size, with the largest measuring approximately 1.5 centimeters in length. These specimens represent hyperplastic parathyroid glands removed during surgical treatment. The findings are characteristic of parathyroid hyperplasia affecting the endocrine system.
